run.name: Skeena Resources Ltd
run.title: CP-OS host session (SKE)
run.summary: Skeena is a pre-revenue, single-asset construction credit that is funded for now but unproven. The evidence supports a cautious, not adverse, view; earnings-based leverage and cover cannot be measured. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.
gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: No EBITDA, cost to complete, or legal terms for the notes are supplied, and the statements are unaudited interim.
CP-1 main limitation: Unaudited interim statements only; no full-year 2025 flows, no EBITDA, no cash interest paid for the half-year, and no legal terms for the notes.
